thoughts: I hope everyone stays warm tonight.
The Frost-Moth banner looks lovely by the fountain.
My town feels so peaceful at this hour.
I should brew some cocoa for the morning.
Pixels are so much fun to arrange.
I wonder if the moon is watching me.
I am quite proud of my little town.
Sleep will be wonderful after this busy day.
